daylight.title: Set up Daylight
daylight.description: Create a fixed-atmosphere daylight reference using Home Assistant's location. Includes illuminance, melanopic EDI, color temperature, normalized level, and geometric solar elevation. This integration does not control lights.

calibrated.title: Add a calibrated light
calibrated.description: Choose a source light with tunable white and a measured bulb curve. Reference illuminance is the lamp-only reading at your chosen position: measure the light off and on at 4000 K and 100% brightness, then enter on minus off.

data_description.reference_lux: Lamp-only lx at the target position, 4000 K and 100% brightness.

melanopic.title: Add a melanopic light
melanopic.description: Select a Calibrated Light whose reference lux was measured at the position and meter orientation you want to model. Eye-level exposure requires a reference measurement at eye level facing the relevant direction. The spectral conversion is currently an estimate from representative CRI 90 LEDs, not a spectrum measured from your bulb.

review.title: Review daily daylight curve
review.description:
Predicted values for {date} at Home Assistant’s location. The three panels show illuminance, melanopic EDI, and color temperature across the local day. Values between simulated directions are interpolated clear-sky estimates. No setting changes until you save.

![Daily daylight preview]({preview_url})

from_elevation.name: Calculate from solar elevation
from_elevation.description: Return lux, melanopic EDI, and CCT on the selected Daylight device's receiving surface for a geometric solar elevation. No state is changed. Capture the response data.

geometric_elevation.name: Geometric solar elevation
geometric_elevation.description: Degrees above the horizon, without atmospheric refraction.

solar_azimuth.name: Solar azimuth
solar_azimuth.description: Optional compass direction of the sun, clockwise from north. Defaults to its current direction; supply a direction for a hypothetical sun position.

from_level.name: Calculate from daylight level
from_level.description: Return lux, melanopic EDI, and CCT on the selected Daylight device's receiving surface for a normalized daylight level. No state is changed. Capture the response data.

daylight_level.name: Daylight level
daylight_level.description: 0 is the dark reference; 1 is today's solar noon.

noon_elevation.name: Noon elevation
noon_elevation.description: Optional geometric noon elevation. Defaults to today's value at Home Assistant's location.

solar_azimuth.name: Solar azimuth
solar_azimuth.description: Optional compass direction of the sun, clockwise from north. Defaults to its current direction; supply a direction for a hypothetical sun position.
